crew.overview: Georges and Anne are in their eighties. They are cultivated, retired music teachers. Their daughter, who is also a musician, lives abroad with her family. One day, Anne has a stroke, and the couple's bond of love is severely tested.
crew.title: Amour

crew.overview: The story of Dian Fossey, a scientist who came to Africa to study the vanishing mountain gorillas, and later fought to protect them.
crew.title: Gorillas in the Mist

crew.overview: Several years after leaving the orphanage, to which her father never returned for her, Gabrielle Chanel finds herself working in a provincial bar. She's both a seamstress for the performers and a singer, earning the nickname Coco from the song she sings nightly with her sister. A liaison with Baron Balsan gives her an entree into French society and a chance to develop her gift for designing.
crew.title: Coco Before Chanel

details.biography:
Catherine Leterrier (born 26 October 1942) is a French costume designer.

Leterrier is the wife of François Leterrier, mother of Louis Leterrier, daughter of André Fabius, she is the sister of Laurent Fabius and François Fabius, and aunt of Thomas Fabius.
